title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: The briefing's licensing, automatic availability, rollout dates and documented controls are supported. Two minor corrections remain: acknowledge conflicting Android release documentation, and reconcile the Facilitator-app checklist instruction with its absence from the controls table.
